title: Prom Night 4 - Deliver Us from Evil
description: Two teenage couples have a terrible time with a killer monk who has escaped from his cell.

title: Creepshow III
description: Ghoulish stories revolve around a remote control, a strange radio, a murderous call-girl, an engagement and a ghost.

title: The Dresden Files
description:
S01 E08 — Storm Front
Harry must delve into the world of dark magic to solve the murders of a local gangster and his girlfriend.

title: The Dresden Files
description:
S01 E09 — The Other Dick
After the murder of a private investigator, Harry and the man's assistant try to uncover the truth.

title: The Slumber Party Massacre
description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

title: Open Grave
description: A man awakes-- without memory -- in a pit full of bodies and must figure out if the people who rescued him are the killers, or if he is the murderer.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S02 E05 — Shelter
Reaching the compound, Rebecca, Brian, Oskar and Nina meet its oddball caretaker Spence and his family; Nina's mental and physical health continues to deteriorate; Mick interrogates Kelly in his lair.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S02 E06 — Return
Rebecca and Brian navigate their way to Mick's lair; Rebecca goes in search of Danny and manages to find him and Kelly hurt, but still alive; arriving at the lair with an almost catatonic Nina, Mick gets ready for a fight.

title: Silent Hill: Revelation
description: When her adoptive father disappears, Sharon Da Silva is drawn into a strange and terrifying alternate reality that holds answers to the horrific nightmares that have plagued her since childhood.

title: Alligator
description: A herpetologist helps a detective track her flushed-away pet, now a king-size mutant called Ramone.

title: Sweet 16
description: Murder and mayhem seem to surround the new girl (Aleisa Shirley) in town as her 16th birthday approaches.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S01 E09 — Fair Haired Child
Two youngsters, one kidnapped and one the son of the kidnappers, develop a special relationship while imprisoned together in a basement.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E03 — The V Word
Two teenage boys break into a mortuary to see dead bodies, but what they find is more than they bargained for.

title: Fear Itself
description:
S01 E13 — The Circle
People who meet each Halloween to tell horror stories suddenly realize they are living one.

title: Fear Itself
description:
S01 E03 — Family Man
A prisoner must protect his family when he inadvertently switches bodies with a serial killer after a near-death experience.

title: Hell House LLC
description: A documentary crew visits Hell House to investigate what really happened 5 years earlier, when 15 people were killed during a haunted house tour.

title: Hell House LLC II: The Abaddon Hotel
description: Eight years after a hotel's tragic opening, an investigative journalist is convinced key evidence remains in the abandoned hotel. She assembles a team to help her break into the building to find the truth and shed light on the mystery.

title: Hell House LLC III: Lake of Fire
description: A host takes his show into an abandoned hotel that is rumored to be haunted.

title: Grave Encounters 2
description: Film students break into an abandoned insane asylum to do paranormal research and quickly discover ghosts are real.

title: Grave Encounters
description: The crew of a ghost-hunting TV show goes insane after being locked in an abandoned psychiatric hospital.

title: The Taking of Deborah Logan
description: Mia records the daily lives of Deborah and her daughter Sarah as part of her thesis. As the days progress, strange things happen around Deborah, and it becomes apparent something has taken control of her.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:
S01 E01 — The Golden Arm (Michigan) -- Part 1
Heather offers Dave a helping hand, but she may never see that hand again.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:
S01 E02 — The Golden Arm (Michigan) -- Part 2
Obsessed with her beauty, Heather insists on an arm replacement made of gold, but it comes at a cost.

title: 50 States of Fright
description:
S01 E03 — The Golden Arm (Michigan)
Dave goes against Heather's last wish to get out of debt, but when someone breaks a promise, the fallout can be deadly.

title: Silent Night, Deadly Night Part 2
description: The younger sibling of the teenager who killed while dressed as Santa carries on in his brother's bloody footsteps.

title: Sleepaway Camp
description: Bunks and the showers are a mad stabber's beat at a summer camp strictly for teens.

title: The Dresden Files
description:
S01 E10 — What About Bob
Harry's latest lover sneaks out of his place with Bob's skull and delivers it to Dresden's uncle.

title: The Dresden Files
description:
S01 E11 — Things That Go Bump
Ancient Mai and Morgan seek refuge at Dresden's place and find themselves trapped by a powerful spell.

title: The House on Sorority Row
description: Seven sorority sisters drown their housemother (Lois Kelso Hunt), then meet the son she hid for 20 years.

title: Uninvited
description: Spring-break teens and an escaped laboratory mutant cat board a yacht with a financier and his henchmen.

title: Rabid
description: Surgery leaves a Montreal motorcyclist (Marilyn Chambers) with a bloodsucking appendage in her armpit.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S01 E01 — Billabong
In the Australian Outback, an American family's vacation takes a nightmarish turn when they meet a local man named Mick Taylor.

title: Wolf Creek
description:
S01 E02 — Kutyukutyu
Haunted by the massacre of her parents and brother, Eve sets out on a quest for revenge; in Kutyukutyu, Eve runs afoul of the local police and lands in a jail cell; Mick Taylor finds out that an American teenager is looking for him.

title: Prom Night
description: An ax killer stalks teens at the prom, apparently seeking revenge for a child's death six years earlier.
